text: Do not drink water the moment you wake up. In Chinese medicine, we have always known that, overnight, the mouth accumulates everything the body was trying to clear while you slept. The moment you swallow that first sip of water, it all goes down with it. There is no money in this knowledge. That is why nobody tells you. In Chinese medicine, we never start the morning with water. We start with something different, something that cleans before anything enters. This is exactly what you need to do. One cup of warm water with half a teaspoon of salt. Gargle for ten seconds, moving the water side to side. Then bring it to the back of the throat for ten seconds more. Do not swallow it. Spit it out. This is how you start the morning the right way. Clearing what built up overnight before it ever gets the chance to go deeper. Now here is what nobody tells you. What starts in the mouth does not stay in the mouth. It travels straight to the gut. Every morning you skip this. You are starting the day without clearing what formed during the night. And a gut that has been starting every morning like that for years, that is where it all piles up. But the gut does not get damaged only by what enters through the mouth. It gets damaged by what lives inside of you. Stress inflames the walls of the intestine. Anxiety slows digestion down. The emotions you swallow every day without releasing literally ferment in there. That is why there are people who eat clean, gargle, take care of themselves on the outside, and are still bloated, foggy, drained, and with their stomach destroyed. Because the problem is not just what goes in. It is what never comes out. The trapped emotions, the accumulated tension, the stress you do not even feel anymore because it became your normal way of living. All of that stays in the gut and slowly rots from the inside. Cleaning your mouth in the morning is the first step. But cleaning what you carry inside is what truly changes everything. Write in the comments, clean from within. If you are going to start this tomorrow, and if you want to learn how to clean not just your mouth and your gut, but everything you carry inside, the stress that inflames, the emotions that ferment, the tension you never release, I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
